custody_and_policy: Opaque task index and generation-aware scoring rules only. Raw query text, labels, expected IDs and description facts remain private. R07 governs current-generation frozen present-source recall@10 ≥0.90 and judged precision@5 ≥0.80, with zero critical forbidden matches; task macro governs and target/item micro is reported alongside. Complete independent blind judgment of every returned top-five item is required before precision acceptance. Full-intention recall covers 49 frozen task slots across all 40 tasks and is reported separately without a numeric threshold; 3,434 is catalog accounting only. Baseline anchors are exact exemplars; release/alias alternatives require pre-evaluation evidence binding, and named vintages are strict. Root has sealed the task intentions, source-anchored input bindings and scoring rules; missing-family and MRF slots require versioned independent bindings before present-source scoring or tuning.

aggregation.multi_intent: Score each frozen target slot separately. A repeated baseline ID or missing family under a different task intent is a distinct task slot; within-task exact duplicates are deduplicated. Per-task recall is hit target slots divided by that task's slot count. Multiple named intake slots remain separate slots and never receive fabricated IDs.
aggregation.target_micro: Report target micro alongside the governing task macro: current-generation present-source recall micro over independently frozen eligible target instances, and adaptive judged precision micro as sum(C_t)/sum(J_t). Full-intention recall micro is sum of retrieved relevant task-target slots / 49 and is reported separately without an acceptance threshold.
aggregation.task_macro: For R07, the current-generation frozen present-source recall@10 task macro is the governing recall metric and must be at least 0.90 over all eligible present-source tasks; the adaptive judged precision@5 task macro is the governing precision metric and must be at least 0.80 only after complete independent blind judgment of every returned top-five item. Report target micro metrics alongside each governing task macro. Full-intention recall remains a separate all-40-task/49-slot report with no numeric threshold; source-absence, zero and undefined cases remain visible.

all_task_denominator.rule: All tasks remain included, including source-absence, unresolved and named-intake cases; no denominator shrinkage after results are seen.

full_universe_recall.binding_rule: Later independently verified intake bindings are versioned and frozen before scoring, never selected from result ranks; a binding can make its existing intention slot scoreable without changing the 49-slot task universe.
full_universe_recall.catalog_accounting_rule: The fixed 3,434-record 1.2.0 catalog universe remains an accounting/disposition denominator only; it is not substituted for relevant retrieval target slots.
full_universe_recall.definition: Full-universe retrieval recall covers every frozen task intention across all 40 tasks, including baseline anchors and named later-intake slots. For task t, hit_slots_t / intention_slots_t uses all slots assigned to that task; an unbound, absent or unresolved slot contributes zero retrieval credit until it has an independently versioned binding before evaluation. This is a retrieval-task denominator, separate from catalog record accounting.
full_universe_recall.missing_and_unresolved_rule: Missing-family, MRF-pilot, source-absence and unresolved slots remain in the 49-slot/full-40 denominator and are separately reported for abstention and intake status.
full_universe_recall.slot_count_rule: The denominator counts task-target slots, not unique corpus IDs: a baseline source ID repeated under distinct task intents is one target slot per task because recall is scored per task. Within a task, exact identities are counted once; baseline, named-missing-family and MRF-pilot lanes are disjoint. Repeated missing families across different tasks remain distinct task slots and are also reported as 12 unique families.

present_source_recall_at_10.definition: For evaluation generation g, freeze the set of source-native target slots with independently verified bindings available before scoring, then count independently judged target IDs retrieved in top ten divided by that generation-specific eligible target instances. Report task macro over tasks with at least one eligible present target and target-instance micro, alongside the full 40-task/intention recall.
present_source_recall_at_10.generation_rule: Any later verified missing-family or MRF binding is added to the generation-specific eligible set only after versioned identity/source/release/access/schema/evidence capture before evaluation; it is never chosen from result ranks.
present_source_recall_at_10.governing_metric: Current-generation frozen present-source recall@10 task macro; target-instance micro is reported alongside and does not replace the task macro.

historical_initial_slice.status: initial baseline snapshot only; later independently verified intake bindings are not permanently excluded

present_source_recall_at_10.missing_family_handling: Unbound named intake slots remain in the full-intention denominator and missing-slot lane; they do not become present-source targets until independently bound.
present_source_recall_at_10.no_eligible_tasks_behavior: No R07 acceptance is possible when the current generation has no eligible present-source tasks; all 40 task statuses and the separate full-intention denominator remain reported.

freeze_and_binding.baseline_anchor: A baseline target is an exact source-native record ID in the fixed 1.2.0 corpus generation and its cited evidence pointer.
freeze_and_binding.binding_version: Before evaluation, any later intake must receive a versioned binding containing source-native identity, source/release, access state, evidence path/hash/pointer and independent verification.
freeze_and_binding.named_intake_intention: A named family or pilot slot without a verified source-native ID remains an intention/missing slot; no ID is fabricated from a title, keyword or related result.
freeze_and_binding.rank_independence: Later intake bindings and target sets are frozen before scoring and are never chosen from result ranks.

target_group_and_release_rule.baseline_exemplars: The 31 exact source-native baseline anchor instances remain the frozen exemplar bindings for this draft; release alternatives are aliases within an existing task slot, not new denominator slots.
target_group_and_release_rule.explicit_vintage: When a query names a vintage or release, the target binding must satisfy that stated vintage/release.
target_group_and_release_rule.predeclared_alternative_binding: Alternative releases/source-native IDs must be declared, versioned and evidence-bound before evaluation, using exact dataset IDs and documented release/family identity where available (including Census). Alternatives are never generated from result ranks.
target_group_and_release_rule.unreviewed_alternative: Until an alternative binding is independently reviewed, its label remains uncertain and qualified scoring for that alternative is blocked; a result is not marked scientifically wrong solely because it is a verified suitable release alternative to the representative baseline year.
target_group_and_release_rule.unspecified_vintage: When a query does not name a vintage, a verified release or alias of the same source-native product may satisfy it only when its documented release/family identity and the task's recency or coverage intent support the substitution. A title match alone is insufficient.

judge_controls.blind_independent_judging: Other retrieved results and critical errors require independent blind judging before implementer tuning.
judge_controls.critical_error_examples: Wrong source family, grain, time interval, price meaning, unsupported authorization/access claim or prohibited CCN=NPI/name-only join.
judge_controls.model_gold_boundary: Model-derived labels and implementer agreement cannot serve as their own gold set or establish scientific precision.
judge_controls.selected_anchor_scope: The selected anchor list is a target input for this draft, not exhaustive relevance gold for every other result.

acceptance_gate.empty_results: A task with no returned top-five items has no returned item to judge, but its empty slots and zero-result/abstention outcome remain reported separately.
acceptance_gate.governing_metric: Adaptive judged precision@5 task macro; item micro is reported alongside.
acceptance_gate.no_judged_returned_items_behavior: No R07 acceptance is possible when no returned top-five item has an independent judgment, even if other metrics are available.
acceptance_gate.no_selective_judging: Do not judge only easy hits or stop after target recovery. Report all returned positions, including apparent errors, duplicates, forbidden substitutions and items from other source families.
acceptance_gate.top_five_judgment_coverage: Every returned result in ranks 1-5 for every evaluated task must have an independent blind judgment before any precision acceptance statement; any unresolved returned top-five item blocks precision acceptance.
acceptance_gate.unresolved_judgment_behavior: Any unresolved returned top-five judgment blocks the precision acceptance decision; no selective judging of easy hits is permitted.

adaptive_returned_item_precision_at_5.definition: For task t, inspect result positions 1 through 5. Let R_t be returned positions, J_t the returned positions with an independent blind judgment, and C_t the judged returned positions relevant to the task intent and free of critical error. Adaptive judged precision is P_t=C_t/J_t only when J_t>0. Report R_t, J_t, C_t, empty_t=5-R_t and unjudged_t=R_t-J_t for every task; empty positions and unjudged returned positions never enter J_t.
adaptive_returned_item_precision_at_5.macro_and_micro: Report the arithmetic mean of defined P_t values with defined-task count and the full 40-task table count; report item micro precision as sum(C_t)/sum(J_t). Tasks with J_t=0 are undefined/unjudged for adaptive precision and remain visible rather than being silently removed.
adaptive_returned_item_precision_at_5.rationale: This measures the quality of returned, judgeable items without making a one-anchor task's precision cap a function of unfilled slots. It does not award recall, abstention, or research-success credit.

missing_slots.rule: Report missing-family and pilot coverage separately; they become scoreable source targets only after versioned independent intake binding.

outcome_lanes.abstention: Zero-anchor, source-absence and unresolved cases are evaluated for typed abstention and avoidance of forbidden substitutions/claims. An empty result alone receives no automatic success credit.
outcome_lanes.research_success: Research or scientific success requires separate independent evidence and domain judgment; retrieval ranks, model agreement and these retrieval metrics cannot establish it.
outcome_lanes.retrieval_positive: Exact source-native baseline IDs recovered in the declared recall lane are retrieval positives; named-intake intentions do not become positives before independently versioned binding.

strict_fixed_k_audit.definition: Also report fixed-k occupancy R_t/5 and strict fixed-k credited score C_t/5 for all tasks, with empty and unjudged positions receiving no fixed-k credit. Keep these raw counts and scores separate from adaptive judged precision; this strict lower-bound audit metric is not a substitute for independent judgments.
strict_fixed_k_audit.empty_positive_failure: For each present-source task, report baseline target IDs missing from top five and top ten, plus empty slots. A missing target is a retrieval coverage/recall failure and does not change the adaptive precision denominator.

precision_and_judgment.unjudged_cases: Results without an independent judgment are reported as unjudged, excluded from adaptive judged-precision credit and retained in the raw returned-slot counts; they are not silently treated as relevant or wrong.
precision_and_judgment.zero_result_negatives: The 14 tasks without baseline anchors remain denominator cases. Evaluate typed abstention, forbidden substitutions/claims and empty-positive behavior in the abstention lane; arbitrary empty output receives no automatic relevance credit.

acceptance_prerequisites.all_tasks: All 40 tasks remain in the evaluation table, including source-absence, zero-result, missing-slot, unresolved and undefined cases.
acceptance_prerequisites.precision: At least one returned top-five item with a judgment is required, and every returned top-five item must be independently blindly judged; any unresolved item blocks precision acceptance.
acceptance_prerequisites.present_source: At least one eligible current-generation present-source task is required; otherwise no R07 acceptance.
acceptance_prerequisites.separate_outcomes: Retrieval positives, typed abstention/source absence, and research/scientific success are distinct outcomes.

threshold_governance.correction_record: This final candidate corrects the earlier draft governance wording: R07 adopted thresholds govern current-generation present-source recall and judged precision; full-intention recall is reporting-only. No threshold was reduced or newly invented.
threshold_governance.full_intention_reporting: Report full-intention recall over the fixed 49 task-target slots across 40 tasks, plus source absence, with no numeric acceptance threshold. The catalog 3,434-record universe remains accounting only.

critical_forbidden_matches.rule: Zero critical forbidden matches in the evaluated returned results; report task-level failures and reviewer uncertainty.

judged_precision_at_5.eligibility: Adaptive C_t/J_t over returned top-five items with independent blind judgments, only after 100% judgment coverage of all returned top-five items.
judged_precision_at_5.item_micro: Report item micro alongside the task macro.

present_source_recall_at_10.eligibility: Current-generation frozen present-source target bindings, versioned before scoring.
present_source_recall_at_10.target_micro: Report target-instance micro alongside the task macro.

source.text: Current-generation, frozen present-source recall@10 ≥0.90; judged precision@5 ≥0.80; zero critical forbidden matches; separately report full-universe recall and source absence. Publish task-level failures and reviewer uncertainty

root_adjudication.scope: Freeze of evaluator-owned retrieval task inputs and scoring methodology only. Scientific relevance gold for every possible result and empirical acceptance are not established.
root_adjudication.immutable_private_candidate: The referenced candidate bytes are preserved. This external root decision supersedes their pending-root workflow flag for input freezing only; draft scientific labels are not upgraded.

corrections_reviewed: Natural research questions preserve intentions without requiring a predetermined unresolved outcome.
Literal publisher facts retain record-level scope and complete definitions; payload, schema, identity and fitness uncertainty remain separate.
Target slots, absence, ranked-result judgment and release bindings have explicit denominators and evidence boundaries.
R07 thresholds govern current-generation present-source recall and judged precision; full-intention recall remains separately reported.

root_adjudication.governance_history: An earlier root instruction incorrectly made full-intention recall govern the recall threshold. The final candidate restores the master plan R07 present-source threshold before implementation tuning; no task, intention, anchor or numeric threshold was removed or lowered.
limitations: No retrieval run, scientific claim qualification, R14 model evaluation, participant study or production release was performed.
Additional returned results require independent blind judgments; selected exemplars are not exhaustive relevance gold.
Later source/release alternatives and intake bindings require independent evidence and a versioned freeze before ranks are observed.
Private raw queries, labels and expected IDs remain outside Git and implementer prompts. Same-user filesystem permissions are not claimed as hostile-process isolation.
